title: LEAF-OPD: Learning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM unlearning aims to erase targeted knowledge from large language models while preserving their utility. However, many existing methods suppress target knowledge without explicitly teaching the model how to respond to queries about it. We propose LEAF-OPD (LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation), in which a frozen teacher provides token-level supervision on student-generated responses. On forget data, the teacher uses privileged contexts (instructions not to reveal knowledge about forget targets) to guide forgetting. On retain data, the teacher provides supervision without privileged context to preserve model utility. The student operates without privileged context in both cases, learning how to respond when encountering knowledge that should be forgotten. translated_title: LEAF-OPD：通过策略内蒸馏从特权上下文中学习遗忘
translated_abstract: 大语言模型遗忘旨在从模型中擦除目标知识，同时保持模型的实用性。然而，许多现有方法只是抑制目标知识，而没有明确教会模型如何回应与这些知识相关的查询。我们提出了LEAF-OPD（通过策略内蒸馏从特权上下文中学习遗忘），其中冻结的教师模型在学生生成的回答上提供token级别的监督。在遗忘数据上，教师利用特权上下文（即不透露遗忘目标相关知识的指令）来引导遗忘；在保留数据上，教师在不使用特权上下文的情况下提供监督，以维持模型的实用性。学生在两种情况下均不使用特权上下文，从而学习到在遇到本应被遗忘的知识时如何作出回应。一个关键挑战在于，教师往往只在学生轨迹的前几个token上提供有效监督。我们引入了Supervisio（摘要此处截断）……
tldr: 提出LEAF-OPD遗忘框架，利用冻结教师模型在学生自生成的回答上进行token级策略内蒸馏——遗忘数据上借助特权上下文引导遗忘、保留数据上无需特权上下文以维持实用性——从而教会模型在遇到应被遗忘的知识时如何恰当回应。
en_tdlr: LEAF-OPD performs LLM unlearning via token-level on-policy distillation from a frozen teacher, which uses privileged contexts to guide forgetting on forget data while supervising without them on retain data, teaching the student how to respond to queries about knowledge that should be forgotten.
